about: Manual check of 40 random PrimeVul test pairs (scratch sampler: random.Random(1).sample over the 564 pairs in file order, first 40). a_to_b = the fix adds a missing safety condition or action for an operation that already exists in the vulnerable function (check, release, lock, sanitising, bounded API, sizing). outside = deciding that B is needed requires information that is not in the function body (callee contract, caller guarantee, how a value is used elsewhere, hardware/protocol semantics). Labelled by Claude on 2026-10-25, one pass, no second annotator.
